A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with all ten pages readable and corresponding equations, figures, tables and references available for comparison. Neither contains an appendix or embedded supplement; supplementary material referenced in both is not included in the supplied files.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification, transfer-learning, segmentation and depth-estimation experiments in Tables 1–4, alongside learning-curve, shape-bias and robustness analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments in Tables 1–4 and the cluster, learning-curve, shape-bias and robustness results in Figures 4–9.

M1.justification: The S-PCL shape-prototype procedure, ReflCL and ShadCL intrinsic-image objectives, combined MidVCL approach and sequential training procedure are unchanged. Sections 3 and 4.3 retain the same components, losses and training sequence.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet-100, ImageNet-1k, STL-10, ADE20K, Cityscapes and NYU Depth V2 for the same tasks. Shape-bias evaluation and the 17 OOD datasets in the model-vs-human benchmark are also retained.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain SimCLR, MoCoV2, PCL, SwAV, BYOL and DINO as baselines. Comparator membership in the hybrid-training comparisons and graphical analyses is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the ImageNet-100 7:3 training/validation split, ResNet18 configuration, 100- and 400-epoch evaluations, and hybrid training with 100 initial plus 300 subsequent epochs. Downstream evaluation procedures and reported metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: The same cluster examples, adjusted-mutual-information analysis, convergence curves, SmoothGrad case studies, style-transfer tests, shape-bias evaluation and OOD robustness analysis appear in both versions. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 9 retains standard-error-of-the-mean error bars and paired t-tests with the same significance thresholds. No repeated-run counts, seed information or additional uncertainty-reporting procedures are introduced.

E6.justification: The table entries and plotted results are unchanged. For example, both report 78.0% ImageNet-100 Top-1 accuracy for S-PCL+MoCoV2 in Table 1, 32.1% ADE20K mIoU for MidVCL in Table 2, and MidVCL RME of 0.1354 in Table 3.

T1.justification: The shape-prototype definitions and loss expressions in Equations 1–3 are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: Both retain the claims of approximately twice-faster convergence on ResNet18, improved downstream representations, and enhanced shape bias and OOD robustness through perceptual pretraining. The abstract, introduction and discussion do not change these claims' scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of early shape-based benefits, later divergence from semantic categories and the task-dependent effects of reflectance and shading are unchanged. Section 6 retains the limitations concerning small models, limited datasets, computing constraints and unexplored perceptual constructs.

D1.justification: Both disclose the same TRACER silhouette generation, Retinex decomposition, ResNet18 encoder, 256-dimensional output and preprocessing procedures. References to further supplementary details remain unchanged, with no new implementation or code/data-access information.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same positioning relative to contrastive learning, dense representations and shape-bias research. The same 35 cited works appear in both versions.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv label updates from v1 dated 1 June 2025 to v2 dated 12 April 2026. The prose, terminology, author information and section organization are otherwise unchanged; extraction-spacing differences do not represent rewriting.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9 and Tables 1–4 retain the same graphics, axes, legends, captions, table structures and placement. Visual inspection confirms that the page layout is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 retains the same methods, empirical evidence, statistical reporting, explanations and limitations. The updated arXiv version/date label does not meaningfully alter scientific support, reproducibility or readability.
